individuals.quote: Offer people actionable feedback about Wikipedia policies while they are editing.

individuals.title: Reference Check

individuals.title: Newcomers feel safe and confident publishing changes they are proud of
individuals.quote: Newcomers and Junior Contributors from Sub-Saharan Africa will feel safe and confident enough while editing to publish changes they are proud of and that experienced volunteers consider useful.

individuals.title: Moderators see better newcomer edits and configure Edit Check
individuals.quote: Moderators at the English and French Wikipedias will notice improvements in the quality of edits newcomers are making and be motivated to configure how Edit Check presents policies to them.

individuals.title: Make existing norms legible and actionable while editing
individuals.quote: we first need to make the norms and standards that are currently in place legible and actionable to people while they are editing

individuals.title: Policies and content reflect the diverse experiences of the people served
individuals.quote: to evolve towards a future where wikis' policies and cultural norms – and ultimately, content – reflect the diverse experiences of the people these projects are intended to serve

individuals.title: Higher quality of newcomer edits in the main namespace

individuals.quote: Increase the likelihood that newcomers and Junior Contributors editing from within Sub-Saharan Africa will accompany the new content they are adding with a reference

individuals.title: Newcomers report feeling safe and confident
individuals.quote: Newcomers and Junior Contributors editing from within Sub-Saharan Africa will report feeling safe and confident making changes to Wikipedia

individuals.title: Experienced volunteers audit and iterate on the default configurations
individuals.quote: Experienced volunteers will independently audit and iterate upon Edit Check's default configurations to ensure Edit Check is causing newcomers and Junior Contributors to make productive edits.

individuals.title: Newcomers are more aware of the need to add a reference
individuals.quote: Newcomers and Junior Contributors will be more aware of the need to add a reference when contributing new content because the visual editor will prompt them to do so

individuals.title: Editing interfaces do not make people aware of policies
individuals.quote: The trouble is that the visual editor and other editing interfaces do not make people aware of the Wikipedia policies and guidelines they are expected to follow.

individuals.title: Good-faith newcomer edits are reverted and newcomers leave
individuals.quote: become disappointed and frustrated when the good-faith change(s) they arrived to the wiki seeking to make are undone (read: reverted), deleted, and/or scrutinized in inequitable ways

individuals.title: Moderation burden on experienced volunteers
individuals.quote: Continually needing to educate inexperienced volunteers and undo their changes can lead to experienced volunteers becoming skeptical of inexperienced volunteers and impatient with them.

individuals.title: Wikipedia projects struggle to grow and diversify their volunteers
individuals.quote: struggle to grow and diversify their volunteer populations and shrink the knowledge gaps present within Wikimedia wikis

individuals.title: Difficulty retaining editors outside Europe and North America
individuals.quote: The movement struggles to retain editors who live outside Europe and North America.

individuals.title: People from Sub-Saharan Africa are underrepresented among editors
individuals.quote: people from Sub-Saharan Africa represent only 1% of active unique editors, despite representing 15% of the global population and 7% of the global internet population

individuals.title: Reference Check A/B test
individuals.quote: Reference Check caused an **increase in the quality of edits** newcomers publish and **did not cause any significant disruption**.

individuals.title: Multi-Check (References) A/B test
individuals.quote: Multi-Check caused statistically significant increases in the proportion of edits that include a reference and are not reverted within 48 hours without causing undesirable changes in edit completion or other forms of disruption (e.g. blocks).

individuals.title: Multi-Check Phase 1 impact analysis
individuals.quote: The findings above suggest this design change has been net positive.

individuals.title: LLMs can evaluate whether sources corroborate claims (English)
individuals.quote: This research confirmed that in English LLMs are effective at evaluating whether web-based sources corroborate claims on Wikipedia.
